programme.desc: Disillusioned with the tedium of his existence, psychiatrist Hector confesses to his girlfriend that he feels he is a fraud for dispensing recommendations to patients who never seem to improve or get any happier. He considers breaking out of his lackluster routine. Summoning up some courage, Hector gives his starved curiosity free rein and embarks on an international quest to find the right formula to bring him joy and vitality. (Comedy drama, Adventure) - 2014

programme.title: Rhymes for Young Ghouls
programme.desc: In 1976, a Mi'gMaq teenager plots revenge against the sadistic Indian agent who imprisoned her in a residential school where rape and abuse are common. (Drama) - 2013

programme.title: The Death and Life of John F. Donovan
programme.desc: A young actor reminisces about a dead American TV star and the correspondence they shared. (Drama) - 2018

programme.title: The Grand Seduction
programme.desc: Residents of a small fishing community in Newfoundland charm a doctor into becoming the town's full-time physician in order to secure a vital factory contract. (Comedy) - 2013

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants
programme.desc: Bridget (Blake Lively), Carmen (America Ferrera), Lena (Alexis Bledel) and Tibby (Amber Tamblyn) are best friends living in Maryland. After many summers together, the four are finally going their separate ways for a few months: while Bridget heads to Mexico, and Lena visits family in Greece, Carmen and Tibby stay closer to home. No matter where they are, they are connected by a pair of jeans that they take turns sharing -- pants that fit all four girls and exemplify their tight bond. (Comedy drama) - 2005

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants 2
programme.desc: Following freshman year at college, best friends Tibby, Lena, Carmen, and Bridget find it increasingly difficult to stay in touch. As their lives take different paths, it may take more than a shared pair of well-worn blue jeans to keep their bonds from completely unraveling. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 2008

programme.title: Sanctuary - Penance
programme.desc: While an old friend of Magnus', a pouched abnormal named Jimmy, is handing over a fire elemental to the Sanctuary team, they are attacked by a gang of criminal abnormals from Chicago; the situation presents a lot of mysteries to be solved quickly. (Science fiction) - 2009-12-11

programme.title: Sanctuary - Sleepers
programme.desc: When rich youngsters begin to disappear after an apparent death and then come back to life, the trail leads Will and Magnus to a drug clinic in Mexico run by Nicola Tesla. (Science fiction) - 2009-12-18

programme.title: Tia and Piujuq
programme.desc: A 10-year-old Syrian refugee living in Montreal finds a magic portal leading to the Arctic. (Drama) - 2018

programme.title: Indian Horse
programme.desc: A Canadian First Nations boy survives in a residential school in the 1970s. (Drama) - 2017

programme.title: The Fugitive
programme.desc: Wrongfully accused of murdering his wife, Richard Kimble escapes from the law in an attempt to find her killer and clear his name. Pursuing him is a team of U.S. marshals led by Deputy Samuel Gerard, a determined detective who will not rest until Richard is captured. As Richard leads the team through a series of intricate chases, he discovers the secrets behind his wife's death and struggles to expose the killer before it is too late. (Action, Thriller) - 1993

programme.title: The Monuments Men
programme.desc: During World War II, the Nazis steal countless pieces of art and hide them away. Some over-the-hill art scholars, historians, architects and other experts form a unit to retrieve as many of the stolen masterpieces as possible. The mission becomes even more urgent when the team learns about Hitler's "Nero Decree," which orders destruction of the artworks if the Third Reich falls. Caught in a race against time, the men risk their lives to protect some of mankind's greatest achievements. (Historical drama, War) - 2014

programme.title: The Big Lebowski
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges plays Jeff Lebowski who insists on being called "the Dude," a laid-back, easygoing burnout who happens to have the same name as a millionaire whose wife owes a lot of dangerous people a whole bunch of money -- resulting in the Dude having his rug soiled, sending him spiraling into the Los Angeles underworld. (Comedy) - 1998

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished; trying to help some teens, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now, David's in big debt to his supplier and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang. (Comedy, Action) - 2013

programme.title: Moving Day
programme.desc: A misfit furniture mover (Will Sasso) fantasizes about leaving his unfulfilling job for an equally unfulfilling job on a municipal road crew. (Comedy) - 2012

programme.title: Lovesick
programme.desc: Dash, a broke and depressed 33-year-old man, is still in love with his ex, Lauren. It all seems hopeless until he meets Nora, a spontaneous and unforgettable woman. But timing is everything, and Nora's not going to wait around. (Drama) - 2016

programme.title: Good Neighbours
programme.desc: Victor is new to Montreal and attempts to make friends with the wheelchair-bound Spencer and the cat-loving Louise, but everybody is on edge with a serial killer terrorizing the neighborhood. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2010

programme.title: Imagine Me & You
programme.desc: During her wedding ceremony, Rachel (Piper Perabo) notices Luce (Lena Headey) in the audience and feels instantly drawn to her. The two women become close friends, and when Rachel learns that Luce is a lesbian, she realizes that despite her happy marriage to Heck (Matthew Goode), she is falling for Luce. As she questions her sexual orientation, Rachel must decide between her stable relationship with Heck and her exhilarating new romance with Luce.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP51 The Second Time Around, Part Two [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin is reunited with Cornelia, a woman who died by her father's hands to save Lupin's life. However, Cornelia's memories of Lupin have been erased. Her father is Dr. Zel, a Nazi who has succeeded in resurrecting corpses and controlling them. Cornelia is caught between the lies her father tells her and her memories of love for Lupin. Will Lupin be able to save Cornelia?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP52 Emmanuelle in Bangkok [English Dub]
programme.desc: Fujiko discovers that the Holy Scripture for Immortality is hidden within the jungles of Thailand. However, Emmanuelle Poirot, a cold-hearted beauty, is after them too. Lupin, love-struck and being manipulated by Emmanuelle, goes to the temple where the Holy Scripture is hidden and takes on the challenge of stealing it. Stuck between two beauties, whom will Lupin get the treasure for?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP53 I Melt With You [English Dub]
programme.desc: Fantômas Mark III, grandson of the mysterious master thief and disguise artist Fantômas, who terrorized Europe during his heyday, is plotting to take over the world. He demands that Lupin deliver the world's largest ruby in exchange for Fujiko, whom he is holding captive.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP54 Mercy Mercy Me [English Dub]
programme.desc: The aging Inspector Hanshichi Mikawa, who failed to capture Lupin 10 years ago, is viewed as a nuisance by his peers at the downtown police station. Lupin has announced he'll be stealing the golden Goddess of Mercy statue.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP55 Kooky Kabuki, Part One [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin and his gang have stolen the "36 Views of Mt. Fuji," a famous series of 46 woodblock prints, from the exhibition hall. However, a gang calling itself the Shiranami Five challenges Lupin head-on by stealing one of the prints from him.

programme.title: Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: Naruto and his team are sent on a mission to guard Yukie Fujikaze, a popular actress starring in the hit movie "The Adventures of Princess Gale."

programme.title: Naruto the Movie: Legend of the Stone of Gelel [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: Drawn into a fierce struggle over the legendary Stone of Gelel, Naruto, Shikamaru, and Sakura must keep the stone from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: Naruto the Movie: Guardians of the Crescent Moon Kingdom [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: Naruto, Sakura, and Kakashi team up with Rock Lee to escort Prince Michiru and his son Hikaru, but a villainous uprising awaits their homecoming.

programme.title: Terror in Resonance [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. - Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.

programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP01 The Revived Phantom Thief Kid [English Dub]
programme.desc: It seems the notorious Kid the Phantom Thief has returned after eight years. At first, high school student and master illusionist Kaito seeks to challenge the magic trick-wielding outlaw out of pride, but then he learns that his deceased father was actually Kid the Phantom Thief, so who is the newcomer? Kaito puts on his dad's old cape, hat, and monocle and takes to the air to get answers.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP02 Blue Birthday [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito finds himself double-booked when a theft he announced beforehand is on the same night as Aoko's birthday party. Complicating matters is the appearance of a group of jewel-collecting thugs who may have had something to do with the murder of Kaito's father.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP03 Hustler vs. Magician [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito goes up against a Syndicate-owned pool hall hustler to win back the Legendary Cue, a treasure once owned by Jii before he was cheated it out of it by the Syndicate boss many years ago. However, things look dire when Jii's pool hall is put on the line and Kaito apparently has no skill with the game.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP04 A Great Detective Comes to Light [English Dub]
programme.desc: A brilliant if arrogant teen detective comes to town, determined to capture Kid the Phantom Thief. This turns the heat up for Kaito, especially since they're classmates. In fact, Kaito becomes Suguru's rival even out of uniform, leading to a "gentlemen's bet" over which of them will go on a date with Aoko.

programme.title: BLEACH: The Movie - Memories of Nobody [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: An evil clan is sending the World of the Living and the Soul Society on a collision course. Can Ichigo and his fellow Soul Reapers save the two worlds from annihilation?

programme.title: BLEACH: The Movie 2 - The DiamondDust Rebellion [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: After the treasured Ouin is stolen, Toshiro Hitsugaya disappears and becomes suspected of treason.

programme.title: BLEACH the Movie 3: Fade to Black [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: Ichigo must fight a lonely battle to save Rukia before the two are forced to part ways forever!

programme.title: BLEACH the Movie 4: Hell Verse [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: Ichigo must travel into the depths of Hell to stop a group of vicious Sinners and save his younger sister Yuzu, unaware that his actions could bring Hell to the World of the Living.
